greeting: Ataniup Aqqutinganik, Irniup, ammalu Anirniup Salumajup atiagut. Inuujuaqti, quviasungnirmik ammalu nunaqjuami qaujimaniqarluta, qanuippit?
penitential: Ataniq, nalligittigut. Kirisii, nalligittigut. Ataniq, nalligittigut.
homily:
Inuusiq una, inuusiq una, inuusiq una. Uqausiq Job-mi uqaqpuq, 'Naked I came forth from my mother's womb, and naked shall I go back again.' Taanna uqausiq, taanna uqausiq, uqumaittuq. Uqumaittuq, kisiani, taanna uqausiq, taanna uqausiq, uummammi saqquqpuq. Benjamin-up inuusia, 15-nik ukiuqaqtilluni, inuusiqaqtilluni, inuit takulaurtangit silataani. Benjamin-up inuusia, taanna 'masterpiece-ngulluni', uummataup salumajunianik ammalu asijinik asujinik tatatitaulluni. Benjamin-up inuusia, 15-nik ukiuqaqtilluni, inuit takulaurtangit silataani: silatualuuniranga, mathematics-mi pialuktuuninga, coding-mi ammalu technology-mi qaujimaninga. Taakkua pitsiaqtut, silataani qaumajut. Kisiani, Benjamin-up inuusia sanningajuup ujaqqatut tomb-tut ippunngilaq. Ben-up uummanga light-vallaalaurpuq, open-vallaalaurpuq, free-vallaalaurpuq. Ben-up uummanga walk-laurpuq Ataniup aqqutingitigut with a pure, simple heart.

'Whoever receives this child in my name receives me,' Jesus says in the Gospel. Think of the way a child holds a secret, or the way they look at a bird in the sky with eyes that have not yet learned to be cynical. Benjamin was that boy. He was the boy who looked at the horizon and saw not a limit, but a runway for his dreams. He was the boy who sat at his keyboard, building worlds in code, his mind moving faster than the machines he loved. He was the boy who giggled when he spoke of 'con chim airlines,' his voice bright with the pure, unburdened joy of a heart that knew it was loved.

Alan, Thao, Ryan—I know the weight you carry. I know the silence that settles in the hallway when the sun goes down. I know the ache that comes when you see a plane in the sky and your first instinct is to tell him, to share the wonder with him. Do not fear this ache. Do not think that this sorrow is a sign of a lack of faith. It is the price of a love that was, and is, magnificent. When Job lost everything, he did not turn away. He fell to the ground, he tore his cloak, and he blessed the name of the Lord. He did not understand the 'why,' and he did not pretend to. He simply stood in the truth of his humanity, before the mystery of God.

There is a profound, quiet truth in the way a bird takes flight, or the way an airplane climbs into the vast, open sky. Benjamin loved that. He loved the freedom of it. He loved the way the world looked from above, from a place where the troubles of the earth seem so small. And that is where he is now. He is in the 'Banquet of Heaven,' soaring in the light of the Father, free from all weight, breathing the pure air of heaven. He is not gone. He is simply in the place where the sun never sets, where the wind does not just blow in circles, but rests in the peace of the Creator.

Ryan, my dear younger brother, Ben's best friend. You stood beside Ben in front of the cockpit display at the museum; you sat beside him on the bench at the laundromat; you stood beside him outside Phở 54 in your scout uniforms. Ryan, Ben loved you with all his heart. You were his partner in adventure, his brother, his daily companion. When you miss him, when the house feels too quiet, remember that Ben's mind and heart were deeply bonded to yours. You carry Ben's memory inside you. Live your life fully, Ryan! Study hard, play, laugh, explore tech or aviation or whatever brings you joy, knowing that your big brother Ben is cheering you on from heaven's best vantage point.

To all aunts, uncles, grandparents, cousins, and friends who loved Benjamin: Ben's life illuminated what it means to be truly wise. He was brilliant in math and computer logic, yet he was humble, respectful, and sweet-natured. He showed us that real intelligence is never loud or boastful; real intelligence is gentle, generous, and full of love. Benjamin’s life was a gift, a reflection of the Light that came into the world through Mary. He was a boy who looked at the world with wonder, a boy who built games and dreamed of 'con chim airlines', a boy who offered his piggy bank to help his uncle. These are not just memories; they are the fruits of a life lived in the grace of God.

To everyone tuning in from afar—especially families who are carrying heavy crosses, parents who grieve, and children who are suffering in hospitals or homes: You are seen by God. The Gospel reminds us today that Jesus' authority is not a heavy hand that crushes us, but a loving hand that heals, sets free, and restores. The Lord is just in all His ways, gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and full of great kindness. He lifts up all who are falling and raises up all who are bowed down. Benjamin Vo is now in that Banquet, standing beside Saint Carlo Acutis. Two brilliant, modern boys who loved technology, who loved the world, but who loved God more. They are not dead; they are more alive than we are. They are soaring in the light of the Father, free from all weight, breathing the pure air of heaven. Ben's legacy continues to flow on earth, like the clean, life-sustaining water from the 'Giếng Gioan Baotixita' well dedicated in his name in Cà Mau, Vietnam. His middle name, Đại Dương—Great Ocean—remains a sign of God's limitless mercy flowing to those in need.

What can we carry out the door today? Today, when you encounter a complex problem, or when your heart feels overwhelmed by sadness, take a slow breath and remember Saint Paul's words: 'For to me life is Christ, and death is gain.' Stop seeking answers only in human logic or earthly worry. Turn your mind to Jesus. Look up at the sky, just like Ben loved to watch airplanes soar into the clouds, and remember that God's authority is peace, God's Word is love, and Benjamin Vo is safe in the Father's eternal embrace. Let us pray: 'Lord Jesus Christ, You spoke with authority in the synagogue and brought peace to the hearts of all. Grant us the mind of Christ, that we may see beyond earthly tears into the eternal light of Your Kingdom. Comfort Alan, Thao, and Ryan with Your deep peace. Hold Benjamin Đại Dương Vo close in Your heavenly joy until we all meet again at Your eternal Banquet. Amen.'
spiritual_communion: My Jesus, I believe that You are present in the Most Holy Sacrament. I love You above all things, and I desire to receive You into my soul. Since I cannot at this moment receive You sacramentally, come at least spiritually into my heart. I embrace You as if You were already there and unite myself wholly to You. Never permit me to be separated from You. Amen.
closing: May the Lord bless you and keep you in His peace. Go in the light of Christ.
standing_petitions: Benjamin Vo-mik ammalu tamainnik nuulauqtunik, Ataniup qaumanirijangani sininnguaqqujavut.
Tamainnik quviangittunik, Ataniq quviasungnirmik ammalu nirijunnarnirmik tunijuqqujavut.

readings.label: Tusaajaujuq 1
readings.text: Ubluq atauhiq, angiliriit Ataniup takulauqtangit Ataniup saniani, Satan-lu takulaurpuq. Ataniq uqaqpuq, 'Namitutai?' Satan uqaqpuq, 'Nunaqjuami.' Ataniq uqaqpuq, 'Job takuvit? Suliujungittuq, Atanirmik kappiasuktuq.' Satan uqaqpuq, 'Job Atanirmik kappiasuktuq? Illit ikajuvutit. Put your hand on him, and he will curse you.' Ataniq uqaqpuq, 'All he has is in your power, but do not touch him.' Job-up irningit nirijut, ubluq atauhiq, tuqullutik. Job anirniqpuq, 'Naked I came, naked I go. Blessed be the name of the Lord!'

readings.label: Tusaajaujuq 2
readings.text: R. Tusaaguk uqausira, Ataniq, tusaaguk uqausira. Ataniq, tusaaguk uqausira. Ataniq, tusaaguk uqausira. Ataniq, tusaaguk uqausira.

readings.label: Tusaajaujuq 3
readings.text: Jiisusiup nutaqqamik tigujauqpuq. 'Whoever receives this child in my name receives me.' John uqaqpuq, 'Master, we saw someone casting out demons.' Jiisusiup uqaqpuq, 'Do not prevent him, for whoever is not against you is for you.'

day: Monday of the Twenty-sixth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
